facts.fact: RTS reports that Senegal's money-transfer providers, through their consultation body CPCP, asked the BCEAO on 8 November 2026 to convene talks on the rollout of its PI-SPI instant payment platform across the UEMOA area.

SEN.note: A regional system, not PAPSS; no licensing or national switch stated.
Nothing on consumer rules or redress.

facts.fact: RTS reports that on 8 November 2026 Senegal's money-transfer providers cited operational difficulties and malfunctions in the PI-SPI regional instant payment platform being rolled out across the UEMOA area, showing it is in operation.

SEN.note: No volumes or named corridor stated.
Nothing on government payments to people.
PI-SPI is described as in rollout with difficulties, but no mobile money service or wallet-to-bank link is stated in service.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
